dimensions.assessment: Affects Small Business Administration operations, congressional oversight committees, and future applicants for SBA disaster loans.
dimensions.evidence: improves accountability in the disaster loan program of the Small Business Administration

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new notification requirements, potential limits on uncollateralized loans when funding drops below 10 percent, and restrictions on SBA official travel for missed reports.
dimensions.evidence: the Administrator may limit the obligation of funds for a direct loan authorized under this subsection to the amount of such a loan for which collateral is required

dimensions.assessment: Requires budget transparency and separate reporting for disaster loan costs and administrative expenses, but does not appropriate new funds.
dimensions.evidence: separate statements of the amount of appropriations requested for the fiscal year for which the budget is submitted for the cost of SBA disaster loans

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple statutes regarding federal agency reporting, budget formats, loan forgiveness restrictions, and GAO/Inspector General reviews.
dimensions.evidence: Section 12091(a) of the Small Business Disaster Response and Loan Improvements Act of 2008 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Includes permanent reporting and budget requirements, alongside a specific 4-year sunset provision for the low-funding loan limitation authority.
dimensions.evidence: Effective on the date that is 4 years after the date of enactment of this Act, section 7(b) of the Small Business Act is amended by striking paragraph (17)

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts of expected administrative savings or future loan shortfalls.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies the Small Business Administration disaster loan program by adding monthly reporting requirements, budget statements, loan limitations during low funding periods, and mandated oversight reviews.
